# Step - label

`label` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Yields the label of each vertex or edge.

## Forms

```text
label()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out_e().label().to_list()   // ["knows", "created", "knows"]
```
